targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, 100.0 * countIf(http_status < 500) / greatest(count(), 1) AS value FROM streampulse.raw_delivery FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
SELECT window_start AS time, node_id, ttfb_p95_ms AS value FROM streampulse.node_metrics_1m FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, quantileExact(0.95)(transfer_ms) AS value FROM streampulse.raw_delivery FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, sum(ifNull(rebuffer_ms, 0)) AS rebuffer_ms, 100.0 * countIf(download_ms > 2000) / greatest(count(), 1) AS risk_percent FROM streampulse.raw_player FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT window_start AS time, node_id, 100.0 * cache_hit_ratio AS value FROM streampulse.node_metrics_1m FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY time
SELECT now() AS time, 100.0 * sumIf(bytes_sent, cache_status = 'HIT') / greatest(sum(bytes_sent), 1) AS value FROM streampulse.raw_delivery FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, sumIf(bytes_sent, cache_status != 'HIT') / 1000000000.0 AS value FROM streampulse.raw_delivery FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost units / successful GB
panels.description: Synthetic unit: origin GB divided by successful edge GB.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, sumIf(bytes_sent, cache_status != 'HIT') / greatest(sumIf(bytes_sent, http_status < 500), 1) AS value FROM streampulse.raw_delivery FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT location, network_id, round(avg(ttfb_p95_ms), 2) AS p95_ttfb_ms, round(100 * avg(error_5xx_rate), 3) AS error_percent FROM streampulse.network_metrics_1m FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY location, network_id ORDER BY p95_ttfb_ms DESC

SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, node_id, 100.0 * max(synthetic_node_rps) / greatest(max(synthetic_capacity_rps), 1) AS value FROM streampulse.raw_delivery FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time, node_id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, 100.0 * countIf(fallback_level > 0) / greatest(count(), 1) AS value FROM streampulse.raw_routing FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT location, network_id, round(max(ttfb_p95_ms), 2) AS peak_p95_ms, round(100 * max(error_5xx_rate), 3) AS peak_error_percent FROM streampulse.network_metrics_1m FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY location, network_id ORDER BY peak_error_percent DESC, peak_p95_ms DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT now() AS time, count() AS value FROM system.kafka_consumers WHERE database = 'streampulse'
SELECT now() AS time, dateDiff('second', max(window_end), now()) AS value FROM streampulse.node_metrics_1m FINAL
SELECT toStartOfMinute(observed_at) AS time, count() AS value FROM streampulse.dead_letters WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT table, assignments, length(exceptions.text) AS exception_count, last_poll_time FROM system.kafka_consumers WHERE database = 'streampulse' ORDER BY table
SELECT now() AS time, countIf(valid_until > now() AND action != 'no_op') AS value FROM streampulse.recommendations FINAL
SELECT created_at, location, network_id, action, reason_codes, confidence, valid_until FROM streampulse.recommendations FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT created_at, location, network_id, current_json, proposed_json FROM streampulse.recommendations FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25
